## Checklist before requesting review

- [ ] Comment `/ug-review` and address the comments.
- [ ] Comment `/integration-test` and address any failures.

> **Note:** If this is your first time contributing to unity-gateway, please request a maintainer to comment for you. Only Databricks org members can comment `/integration-test`, because it runs your changes with CI secrets; ask a maintainer to run it after they review your changes.
